summary.scope: Only the final frozen app/test pair earns current toggle/callback credit. Earlier driver/candidate failures and incomplete pipelines remain separate; Back observations earn no toggle or Back-repair credit. No unrun work or private-original identity is certified.

publication_rules: Raw identity copies preserve CRLF. Declared host prefixes, temporary directories and isolated32hex owners are redacted; XML placeholders are escaped. Record projections contain only allowlisted fields. Private originals/settings/owners and fingerprints are excluded.
